national_news.title: IAF and Japan's JASDF Conduct Joint Air Exercise 'Veer Guardian 2026' in Jodhpur
bullets: Indian Air Force Chief Air Chief Marshal AP Singh and Japan Air Self-Defense Force Chief General Takehiro Morita flew in a formation sortie in India's indigenous LCA Tejas during 'Veer Guardian 2026' in Jodhpur.
This marks the first time Japanese fighter aircraft (F-2A) operated from Indian soil as part of a bilateral defense exercise.
The 14-day exercise featured advanced operational missions involving IAF's LCA Tejas, Su-30MKI, and Rafale alongside Japanese F-2A fighters.

national_news.title: President Droupadi Murmu Emphasizes Community-Centric Climate Action at New Delhi Summit
bullets: President Droupadi Murmu addressed the valedictory session of the conference on the 'Future of Environment and Climate Dynamics' in New Delhi.
Stressed the need for people-centric adaptation rooted in traditional knowledge, sustainable afforestation, and public participation through the 'Mission LiFE' initiative.
Highlighted the National Green Tribunal's (NGT) role in creating compliance frameworks for river conservation, air quality, and waste management.

national_news.title: IWAI Showcases Bogibeel IWT Terminal Operations along National Waterway-2
bullets: Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI) outlined cargo and multimodal capabilities of the Bogibeel IWT Terminal on Brahmaputra's National Waterway-2 (NW-2).
The Bogibeel terminal features a berthing capacity for 1,000 MT vessels and handles an annual cargo capacity of 6 lakh MT, serving petroleum, coal, tea, and Over-Dimensional Cargo (ODC).
NW-2 stretches 891 km from the Bangladesh border to Sadiya; lessons from its development are being adapted for Odisha's National Waterway-5 (NW-5) on the Brahmani–Mahanadi river system.

national_news.title: Union Sports Minister Leads 91st 'Sundays on Cycle' Drive in Nagoya for Asian Games 2026
bullets: Union Minister for Youth Affairs & Sports Mansukh Mandaviya led the 91st 'Sundays on Cycle' event at Meijo Park in Nagoya, Japan, to mobilize diaspora support for India's 500+ athlete contingent at the Asian Games 2026.
The cycling initiative is organized under the Fit India Movement by MYAS in collaboration with the Cycling Federation of India (CFI), Raahgiri Foundation, and MY Bharat.
The drive is conducted weekly across all States/UTs, SAI Regional Centres, Khelo India Centres, and over 6,000 NAMO Fit India clubs.

national_news.title: Rashtriya Sankalp Samaroh Organized Under Nasha Mukt Yuva Abhiyan
bullets: The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports organized the Rashtriya Sankalp Samaroh across 1,067 locations nationwide to eradicate drug abuse among youth.
The event is part of the 'Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat- 100 Weeks Nasha Mukt Yuva Abhiyan'.
Activities included the Nasha Mukt Pledge, signature campaigns, thematic street plays, and youth-led discussions across 471 District MY Bharat Offices and partner organizations.

national_news.title: Indian Air Force to Host First-Ever Three-Day Air Show in Varanasi
bullets: The Indian Air Force (IAF) is scheduled to hold a three-day aerial display over the Ganges in Varanasi on October 22, 23, and 25, 2026.
More than three dozen aircraft, including Rafale jets, Suryakiran aerobatic team, Tejas, Rudra, C-295, and Dakota, will perform aerial maneuvers.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi is expected to attend the final day as chief guest for the historic event covering the ghats from Namo Ghat to Assi Ghat.

national_news.title: Prime Minister Narendra Modi distributes over 51,000 appointment letters at the 20th Rozgar Mela
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi distributed over 51,000 appointment letters to newly recruited youth in various government organizations via video conferencing at the 20th Rozgar Mela.
The Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana has been launched with an outlay of around one lakh crore rupees to enable nearly two crore youth to enter the workforce for the first time.
India has signed Free Trade Agreements with nearly 40 countries in recent years to open new career and economic opportunities for the youth.

national_news.title: Nepal Finance Minister Calls for Renewed India-Nepal Economic Partnership
bullets: Nepalese Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle addressed an international seminar on 'Reimagining India-Nepal Relations in an Emerging Global Order' organized by RIS in New Delhi.
Key topics included cross-border connectivity, joint energy projects, disaster management investments, and early warning climate risk systems.
The Ministry of External Affairs emphasized expanding bilateral ambition across trade, power, education, and development cooperation.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government to Implement Pay Scale for Non-Financed Education Workers
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister announced the implementation of a pay scale for non-financed education workers and teachers, with a committee headed by the Chief Secretary already working on it.
The state government has disbursed Rs 18,000 crore through the Student Credit Card scheme to support higher education.
A total of 700 model schools currently cater to 3.5 lakh children, while 1.42 lakh students are being taught through the Vidyarthi Saathi app.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Chief Minister Inaugurates 'Viksit Bihar' Brainstorming Session
bullets: Chief Minister Samrat Chaudhory inaugurated the 'Viksit Bihar: Foundation to Construction' brainstorming session at Bapu Sabhagar in Patna.
Highlighting financial growth, Bihar's 2024 budget reached Rs 3.17 lakh crore, surpassing Jharkhand's budget of Rs 1.39 lakh crore.
Key initiatives highlighted include 700 model schools, academic sessions in 211 degree colleges, and the 'Vidyarthi Saathi' app for digital learning.

bihar_news.title: Surge in Demand for GI-Tagged Marcha Chuda from West Champaran, Bihar
bullets: Demand for the aromatic 'Marcha Chuda' (flattened rice from West Champaran) has surged domestically and internationally following its GI tag.
The variety is known for its unique aroma, black peppercorn-like grain shape, and organic cultivation methods using traditional techniques in Champaran farmlands.
It is currently priced at around Rs 150 per kilogram and is being transported to states like Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, Odisha, Uttarakhand, and Jharkhand.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Approves Rs 3,516 Crore Infrastructure Package for Gaya's Sacred Geography
bullets: The Bihar government approved a Rs 3,516 crore infrastructure package on September 15, 2026, to boost religious tourism and the pilgrimage economy in Gaya.

The package includes the Rs 2,520 crore redevelopment of the Vishnupad Temple precinct along the lines of Varanasi's Kashi Vishwanath Corridor, implemented by the Bihar State Road Development Corporation.
It also includes a Rs 996.05 crore project to link the Son and Falgu rivers to address water challenges in the region.
Provisional tourism data for January-July 2026 recorded 1.14 million domestic and 96,465 foreign visitors in Gaya, alongside 1.46 million domestic and 134,000 foreign visitors in Bodh Gaya.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Health Department Directs 100% Digital OPD Registration in Government Hospitals
bullets: The Bihar Health Department directed all government hospitals to ensure 100 per cent digital registration of patients in outpatient departments (OPDs) using ABHA-based registration and electronic health records (EHRs).
During a review meeting chaired by Health Secretary Kumar Ravi, mandatory registration through the Bhavya portal was also instituted for patients admitted to inpatient departments.

The department reviewed key health initiatives, including the TB-Free Bihar and Anaemia-Free Bihar campaigns, maternal and child healthcare, and upgradation plans for district and community health centres.

bihar_news.title: Chief Minister Samrat Chaudhory Highlights Bihar's Economic and Educational Growth
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Chaudhory inaugurated the 'Viksit Bihar: Foundation to Construction' brainstorming session and 'Lav-Kush Pratibha Samman Samaroh' in Patna.
Highlighted the state's budget growth, stating Bihar's 2024 budget reached Rs 3.17 lakh crore, surpassing Jharkhand's Rs 1.39 lakh crore budget.
Informed that academic sessions commenced in 211 degree colleges simultaneously on July 15, with 700 model schools and 75,000 teachers connected via the 'Vidyarthi Saathi' app.
